_comment: FO texprep config (TEXTURE_PLAN 1.2, 1.4 step 7, 4; LOOK_V2 5.1, 5.4; TEXTURES.md final sets LeafSet024 / LeafSet029). DRAFT until TP-0 publishes the texprep schema: field names follow TEXTURE_PLAN 1.4 and SU's surface.json and are renamed to TP's schema when texprep.py lands. Bark and Moss are SU rows (surface.json). One processed set per key: a 2 x 2 flipbook of cluster sprites (cells = sprites), each sprite = one leaf-cluster card of `spriteMetres` metres composed from the source atlas leaves at true leaf size (source leaf ~0.13 m on the 0.40 m LeafSet024 atlas, drawn at `leafScale` x). Opacity -> alpha (straight, linear in BC7), colour push-pull dilated into alpha 0; normals rotated in-plane with each leaf; height and AO from the stacking order (lower leaves darker, AO = 1 - aoDepth x layers above, then the class contrast). contrast = luminance std / mean of the albedo variation over alpha > 0.5 texels (leaves 0.40); satMax = mean HSV saturation cap of token x 2 x variation (0.45); smooth = absolute perceptual smoothness range (dry; LOOK_V2 5.1 leaves roughness 0.60 dry)

LeafIvy.leaves: all except the two autumn leaves (TEX-R)
